title: Professional Advancement - Speech-Language Pathology Assistant
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Professional Advancement - Speech-Language Pathology Assistant, Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Recipients of the Professional Advancement Certificate in Speech-Language Pathology Assistant will demonstrate correct use of screening and treatment procedures for speech-language disorders.

Recipients of the Professional Advancement Certificate in Speech-Language Pathology Assistant will determine appropriate materials to be used in therapy for objectives targeted using appropriate stimuli, cues, prompts, and task-modification behaviors associated with the objectives.
Recipients of the Professional Advancement Certificate in Speech-Language Pathology Assistant will be able to implement techniques for reinforcement.

Recipients of the Professional Advancement Certificate in Speech-Language Pathology Assistant will demonstrate ability to carry out Speech-Language Pathologist directed plans per individual client needs in both 1-on-1 or group settings and document client progress.

notes: SLPA A190 (SLPA Clinical Experience 1, 4.5) and SLPA A250 (SLPA Clinical Experience 2, 5.5) are required in the catalog but absent from the closed list; recorded as catalog additions.
Catalog titles SLPA A180 'Screening and Therapeutic Processes'; the state file lists 'Screen & Therapeutics'.
Total Units 18 printed in requirements and program sequence; matches sum of listed courses.
Career taken from the 'Career Opportunities in Allied Health' heading; the description also names a career as a 'Speech Language Pathology Assistant (SLPA)'.
